correctness.rationale: For any integer d>=5 and frequency k, the radius-Laplace transform factorizes as 2^d s^(d-1)/prod(s^2+y_i). Exact partial fractions yield the odd/even confluent divided differences, including repeated nodes. On integer lattice nodes odd f vanishes, even g and g' vanish. The isolated double (odd) or triple (even) residue is provably nonzero for nonzero repeated nodes. Counting generic collision strata and bounding their intersections yields each leading coefficient and one-power-lower remainder; finite checker corroborated dimensions 3..8 at high precision.

value.rationale: The high-dimensional cross-polytope is a natural convex test body in lattice Fourier analysis and periodization. The theorem determines the exact leading growth exponent and coefficient of its nonzero integer Fourier lattice modes for every d>=5, exposing an unexpected parity jump in support codimension from one to two. This is structural information not provided by a single low-dimensional census or a generic formula for the Fourier transform, and it guides sharp truncation of lattice-frequency computations.
